1669-5531-6621-8345.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
1669-5531-6621-8345.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Repeat.

141-5100-6798.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5100-6798.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1453-4694-6798-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-4694-6798-7306.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Repeat from step 1.

1981-2415-2438-5933.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2113-3590-4222.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald by tapping it, adding {U}.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Warchanter Skald.
Repeat.

225-4365-4772-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3967-7940--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Support Mission triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat

1895-2781-5998-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

4460-5477-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4460-5477-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4460-5477-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

104-6719-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-6719-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-7070-7444.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
1069-7070-7444.description:
Activate an Equipment's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Equipment's ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Advanced Reconstruction.
Repeat.

1308-5086-5183-5231-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1308-5086-5183-5231-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

4423-4637-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {6}{G}{U}, creating two token copies of Omnath and Mystic Sanctuary.
Put all but one of the newest Omnath tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Mystic Sanctuary token created triggers, each Omnath you controlled prior to step 2's second abilities trigger twice, and each of the created Omnath token's first abilities trigger once.
Resolve both Mystic Sanctuary abilities, putting Doppelgang and up to one other instant or sorcery from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve both Omnath tokens' first triggers, causing you to draw two cards, including Doppelgang.
Resolve the remaining Omnath triggers, causing you to gain 8 life, add {R}{R}{G}{G}{W}{W}{U}{U}, and perform other actions dependent on how many times the specific abilities have triggered that turn.
Repeat.
4423-4637-5352.notes: You may cast Doppelgang for more mana each time to also create copies of other permanents. The Mystic Sanctuary tokens can also be tapped for mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4460-5500.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4460-5500.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1939-3490-4050-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1939-3490-4050-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}
When the Servo dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Lunarch Veteran or Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain life
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

1084-3108-3455.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Vizier of Many Faces.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Vizier of Many Faces by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-3263-4853-6798.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

191-5437-6625.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
191-5437-6625.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding a card.
Curator of Mysteries triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Repeat.

1309-2034-4871-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
1309-2034-4871-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Salvager of Secrets and at least two other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing three of the creatures returned in step 1, adding six {C}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate the three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

997-3394-6249--5.notablePrerequisites:
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
997-3394-6249--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Weatherlight Compleated trigger.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

222-527-997-1849.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-997-1849.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

586-1594-5258-5618-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1, creating a Blood token.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1912-3388-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Moritte of the Frost has a power of at least 2.
1912-3388-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Moritte of the Frost and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Moritte of the Frost from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Moritte of the Frost to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Moritte of the Frost enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Moritte of the Frost by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

573-1479-4493.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying {3}{U}, creating a token copy of Kodama of the East Tree that isn't legendary.
Play Gruul Turf.
Kodama of the East Tree, the Kodama of the East Tree token, and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree token's trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield.
The Kodama of the East Tree token and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree token's trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Gruul Turf trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying {3}{U}, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Kodama of the East Tree with haste.
Play Gruul Turf.
Both Kodama of the East Trees and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
The token Kodama of the East Tree and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree and Gruul Turf trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

717-779-2353-3251.description:
Cast Psychic Miasma by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Niv-Mizzet's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Psychic Miasma, discarding Dakmor Salvage and returning Psychic Miasma to your hand.
Bone Miser's second ability triggers, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

2390-4651-5299.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put a counter on a permanent or player.
Phyresis attached to All Will Be One.
2390-4651-5299.description:
Put a counter on a permanent or player.
All Will Be One triggers, giving an opponent a poison counter.
Repeat step 2.

2034-3895-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Diregraf Horde.
When Diregraf Horde enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2660-2757-4050-4537.notablePrerequisites:
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
You control at least one basic land.
2660-2757-4050-4537.description:
Cast Squadron Hawk by paying {1}{W}.
Squadron Hawk enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping Squadron Hawk, untapping a basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squadron Hawk, adding {W}.
Squadron Hawk is put on the bottom of your library instead of your graveyard due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Squadron Hawk trigger from step 2, searching your library for Squadron Hawk and putting it into your hand.
Repeat.

1953-4251-4493.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying {3}{U}, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Godo.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token, then causing all creature tokens you control to become copies of the Godo token.
Declare any Godo token as an attacker.
The Godo token triggers, untapping itself and all Samurai you control, and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1872-1908-2011.description:
At the beginning of combat during your turn, Rionya triggers, creating at least one token copy of Composite Golem.
Activate a Composite Golem token by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and getting an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
